newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan to celebrate Eid al-Adha holiday April 16.
newsitem.headline: Jordan to celebrate Eid al-Adha holiday April 16.

text.p: Jordan said on Wednesday it will observe a five-day public holiday starting from April 16 to mark the Moslem Eid al-Adha feast, the state news agency reported.

Petra news agency quoted a directive issued by the Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali as saying government offices and public corporations will be closed during that period with civil servants back at work on Monday April 21.
Banks and the Amman Financial Market would also be closed during that period.
